content:
name: Pages reviews

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: "23 4 * * *"
  workflow_dispatch:

concurrency:
  group: pages-reviews
  cancel-in-progress: false

permissions:
  contents: write

jobs:
  prune:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v5
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.event.repository.default_branch }}
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v5
        with:
          node-version: "24"
      - name: Git identity for gh-pages commits
        run: |
          git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git config user.email "41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
      - name: Drop reviews older than 30 days
        run: node --experimental-strip-types .agents/skills/pages/scripts/pages-review.ts prune --ttl-days 30
